text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash pulls ahead! Eishin Flash
claims first
place!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash is the Derby champion?!
Incredible!
She did it! Congrats, Lady
Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah, right... I won, which means...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I've become the Derby champion... Me...

text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You would be super, toll und klasse,
Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(Mother... I have achieved something
incredible.)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: (I've won the Derby!)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If I ever get the chance to win in such a
major
race again, I hope my parents can
be there to
witness it...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: Congratulations, Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: Flash?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My apologies. I am still terribly worked
up from
the race... I should be able to
regain my
composure momentarily.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I mustn't. This race has concluded, and
my task is
complete.
choice_data_list: Why not soak in the moment a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Which means it's time to think about my
next
step.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's unsightly to be unable to control
one's own
emotions.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But if I don't contain myself, I'll become
even
greedier...
choice_data_list: Of course you're happy to win.
Of course you're happy to win.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
If I allow these emotions to continue
lingering...
choice_data_list: Desire?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I fear I will never be satisfied with
anything other
than victory.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Is that really so? Placing is remarkable
enough in
itself though.
choice_data_list: That is only natural!
That's only natural, you know!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's why placing within the top three
has always
been my goal. But now...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes! Absolutely!
choice_data_list: Let's win the next one too, Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin planning for my next race at
once.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We must prepare for the final race of the
Classic
Triple Crown—the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's—
choice_data_list: All right, let's head back to the waiting room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment we step inside the waiting
room,
Eishin Flash receives a message
from her parents.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on getting first place!
It's still
morning here, but countless
regulars and
neighbors have already
stopped by to pass along
their
felicitations."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... How kind of them. "We wish we
could give
you a hug and cheer you on
in person right now."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Winning first place is an achievement
like none
other. It proves just how hard
you have worked
and how strong you
have become."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"We hope the joy of your future victories
will
keep you buoyed and fulfilled."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
They do... Since they have no plans to
visit Japan
during these three years...
choice_data_list: Looks like they were pleased.
Looks like they were pleased.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The least I can do is report as many
victories to
them as possible.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have accomplished all I sought to
according to
my timetable. Let's keep up
the momentum and
continue on.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But before that, there is something I
would like to
report to you. I'm sure it is
nothing serious, but...
choice_data_list: Yeah!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I can't accept this. Why are you
removing the
Kikuka Sho from my
schedule?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the race, Eishin Flash informed me
that her
leg felt strange, so I took her to
see a doctor.
There, we found out it's
because her muscles are
overfatigued.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But there is more than enough time for
me to fully
recover before the Kikuka
Sho.
choice_data_list: The pain will only get worse if you don't rest.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I cannot follow your logic. Doesn't it
make more
sense to set the goal first so
we can base our plan
around it?
choice_data_list: Of course, if you're up for it, let's run.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: Can you promise me you won't overdo it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kikuka Sho is such a grueling race
that it's
said only top racers can win. If
she insists on
running it, she will only
become more fatigued.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes, but—
choice_data_list: Your goal is to 'run it all the way through,' right?
Your goal is to 'run it all the way through,' isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: I want you to keep your promise.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Promise me that you'll adjust your
schedule when
I deem it necessary.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Promise me that you'll adjust your
schedule when
I deem it necessary.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Promises are... eternally binding...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Very well. Let's remove the Kikuka Sho
from my
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The most important thing is that I
complete every
race...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I'm fine. Excuse me.
choice_data_list: ...Are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: My perfect schedule...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: What should I do?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I should ask my parents—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, I cannot discuss this with them. They
must
never know that this failure was
due to my own
mismanagement...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...And that I wasn't good enough.
